sp.conditionalHint: After this unit uses Skill; configure summons and memosprites manually for actual effects. Cooldown is checked before the selected outcome; no random sampling. A 1-turn cooldown skips the next own turn. A proc with an unknown balance still starts cooldown; its refund amount is unknown.

ledger.title: Skill Point ledger by cycle
ledger.scope: Cycle 0 includes opening operations; boundary operations belong to the new cycle. Skill restoration, external refunds and turn-end refills are separate. Storage deposits are not counted twice. Only committed results count; unknown cycles have no complete totals. The final cycle may be partial.

batch.title: Set skills in bulk
batch.scopeHint: Only allied actions displayed in the current simulation are eligible, including the blocked action. The simulation budget is not expanded. After current uses the Inspector selection.
batch.overwrite: Existing skill annotations on {count} nodes will be overwritten.
batch.confirmHint: Confirm to commit all annotations at once. Replay may make some nodes unreachable; their original anchors retain the annotations.
